name: perflens
description: Turn PerfLens browser audits into reviewed, verified source-code fixes in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Convert browser audits into verified code fixes.
interface.longDescription: Import a PerfLens Portable Audit Package, connect findings to the current web project, implement minimal reviewed fixes, run acceptance checks, and export a Fix Session for Chrome retesting.
defaultPrompt: Import this PerfLens audit and explain the highest-impact fixes.
Implement the safe P0 and P1 fixes from my PerfLens report.
Verify these fixes and export a PerfLens Fix Session.
